Committee: Fiscal Responsibility and Economic Development
Sponsor: Jones
Analyst: Daniel Davenport
Date: 04/20/2021
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 397 as introduced allows the Alcohol Beverage Control (ABC) Board to issue a wine manufacturer license that authorizes the licensee to manufacture wine in a dry county for distribution outside of the dry county. This bill could increase receipts to the State General Fund by an undetermined amount dependent on the number of wine manufacturers that apply for a license and license renewal to manufacture wine in a dry county.
Steve Livingston, Chairperson
Fiscal Responsibility and Economic Development

This bill could increase receipts to the State General Fund by an undetermined amount dependent on the number of wine manufacturers that apply for a license and license renewal to manufacture wine in a dry county.

Fiscal Responsibility and Economic Development

Committee: Economic Development and Tourism
Sponsor: Jones
Analyst: Daniel Davenport
Date: 05/03/2021
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 397 as passed the Senate could increase receipts to the State General Fund by $500 annually for each wine manufacturer licensed by the Alcohol Beverage Control (ABC) Board to manufacture wine in a dry county for distribution outside of the dry county pursuant to this bill.
Becky Nordgren, Chair
Economic Development and Tourism
